title: ready-02: the connection — clients attach to the server over a local socket; RPC, events, detach/attach
summary: The local socket carries client-server traffic and scripts' RPC lines; windows detach and attach; several windows per session.
description:
Second step of the server/client model. Depends on the server/client split phase (ready-01b). F012 accepted decisions "heca runs standalone or as a server…" and "Two windows on one session…".

## Current state
- RPC language: `heca/src/rpc.rs` (`parse_rpc` :132, `introspect` :86) — one line runs any action in the ActionCatalog; entry points `HecaApp::execute_rpc_command` (`heca/src/main.rs:77`) and `query_rpc_command` (:125), waiting for a listener that was never built. CLI table: `heca/src/app/cli.rs`.

## Goal
- The server listens on a **local-only** socket (Unix socket; named pipe on Windows), owner-only, in a runtime folder.
- Clients (windows) attach over it: they receive state changes and terminal snapshots + changed rows, and send actions and input. Closing a window detaches; the session keeps running.
- Several windows on one session: shared content, each with its own view; a "follow" option to mirror another window; terminal size per pane decided by the setting `smallest` | `latest` | `largest` (default `latest`).
- Scripts use the same socket: `heca rpc <line>` runs an action and gets an answer; `heca rpc --events` streams events. One way in — every registered action is reachable.
- Never on the network for now (remote clients need login and encryption: later).

## Done when
- Close the window while a long command runs; `heca` again attaches and it is still running with its scrollback. Two windows on one session move independently; typing in one resizes a shared pane per the setting. `heca rpc split_horizontal` works from a shell.

tasks.title: Local socket + `heca rpc <line>` for scripts
tasks.description: ready-02a. The local-only, owner-only Unix socket in a runtime folder (stale-socket cleanup), and the one-shot `heca rpc <line>` script door that runs any catalogued action through the existing RPC path (`execute_rpc_command`/`query_rpc_command`) via a new `AppEvent::Rpc`. The rest of P099 (wire model, headless server + attach/detach, several windows, `--events`, Windows pipe, docs) is split into sibling tasks. Built on `heca/src/server/socket.rs`. Windows pipe is its own task.

checklist.title: Local-only socket per server in a runtime folder; owner-only; stale sockets cleaned
Client protocol: state changes + terminal snapshots/changed rows out; actions + input in
Detach on window close; attach again with scrollback intact
Several windows per session: own view each, `follow` option, pane size setting smallest|latest|largest (default latest)
`heca rpc <line>` and `heca rpc --events` for scripts, same one way in

tasks.title: Serializable wire model — plain-data Change + terminal snapshot/damage + layout effects
tasks.description: ready-02b. A plain-data, serde-serializable wire form of the server→client interface: `Change`, `TerminalSnapshot`/`TerminalDamage` (a wire snapshot, NOT the wezterm/image-backed in-memory one), and the layout `SpaceEffect`/`PaneEffect`/`ColumnEffect` + geometry. heca-core has no serde today. Foundation the socket carries. Depends on T521.

tasks.title: Headless server process + attach protocol (detach/attach)
tasks.description: ready-02c. The server runs without a window (no winit/GPU) so it survives the window closing; a window attaches over the socket as a pure client (sends actions/input, receives Changes + terminal snapshots/changed rows). Closing a window detaches; `heca` again reattaches with scrollback intact. Standalone = server + one client in one process, one code path (decision d108b88c). Depends on the wire model (ready-02b).

tasks.title: Several windows per session — own view each, follow, pane size setting
tasks.description: ready-02d. Several windows attach to one session: shared content, each its own view (per-window since P104); a `follow` option to mirror another window; a running pane's size when several windows show it decided by setting `smallest|latest|largest` (default `latest`, decision 463ccd07). Depends on attach protocol (ready-02c).

tasks.title: `heca rpc --events` — stream events to scripts
tasks.description: ready-02e. `heca rpc --events` streams the session's events (the same ones a window reacts to) to a script over the socket. Depends on the attach protocol (ready-02c) carrying events.

tasks.title: Windows named-pipe transport
tasks.description: ready-02f. The Windows path for the control socket: a named pipe, owner-only, behind the same interface the Unix socket uses (`crate::server::socket` is `cfg(unix)` today). Depends on T521 (the socket seam).

tasks.title: Connection / attach architecture docs
tasks.description: ready-02g. Extend docs/server-client-architecture.md (or a sibling) with the socket, the attach/detach model, several windows and the size setting, and `heca rpc`. Depends on the model existing (ready-02c/d).
